payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-19, first-hand in prose in vc's session, read by 09:47Z on vc's date -u; the recommendation's wording is vc's and hv's reply is hv's own words) ISSUE 0705 IS FIXED BY CONSTRUCTION, IN ITS OWN THREAD IN THIS RELEASE, AND ST0095's WP-13 IS ic's. vc asked whether a forge should merge any number of open merge requests with no hand step, by construction, and recommended yes, by two changes: (1) the two generated lists, intent/st/steel_threads.md and intent/todo.md, leave git, and every clone renders them from its own store, at the cost of the forge's web view no longer showing them; (2) whether a record is realised on disk is carried by the record or derived from its status, so creating a record writes no shared manifest, and which of the two is cc's call on meaning. The alternative, keeping the files with one hand step per merge request, is not taken. hv: "Ok, when you're back, crack on.", which vc takes as acceptance of the recommendation. Two merge requests that change one thread still meet in that thread's own file, and 0705's thread says what closing that would take. vc measured before asking: git's union merge driver resolves .intentfiles and a list in a working-tree git merge, and a bare-repository git merge-tree on git 2.56.1 ignores it unless attr.tree or --attr-source is set, which only a forge's configuration decides. On WP-13, vc said that unless hv started ac, ic drafts the docs while it waits for cc's resolver; hv did not start ac.
